description: Cheap half of the ISS-022 split: at tool-call time, stat the config file the server loaded at spawn (track its resolved path + mtime from loadConfig); if the file's mtime is newer than the captured one, emit a ONE-TIME stderr warning that the on-disk config differs from the running config and a client restart/reconnect is needed to apply it. No reload, no behavior change — just kills the silent-staleness trap. Handle: config that came from defaults (no file — also cover the file APPEARING after spawn), env RB_CONFIG_PATH source, stat errors (stay quiet). ~20 lines + tests. Does not resolve ISS-022 by itself (the reload half remains).
title: Warn when .reviewbridge.json changed on disk after MCP server spawn (ISS-022a)
